newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria, U.S. to build a $25 mln medicine plant.
newsitem.headline: Algeria, U.S. to build a $25 mln medicine plant.

text.p: Algeria's state-owned pharmaceutical company Saidal and U.S. Pfeizer group signed an accord to build a $25 million factory for manufacturing medicines, the official news agency APS said on Thursday.
The plant will be operational starting October 1998, APS said.
A joint-venture dubbed "Pfeizer Pharm Algerie company", with a $1.8 million capita was set up in 1994. The U.S. group holds 60 percent stake and the remainder shared by local firms.
Saidal covers 20 percent of the country's medicine needs.
